message: Azure specs should not be using decorator "$extension" from @typespec/openapi or @azure-tools/typespec-autorest. They will not apply to other emitter.
Get endpoints for collections of resources must only have the `value` and `nextLink` properties in their model.

Operation 'getCustomDefaults' returns a list/pageable response and should use method name starting with 'list'. Note: If you have already shipped an SDK on top of this spec, fixing this warning may introduce a breaking change.
Per the Noun_Verb convention for Operation Ids, the noun 'CustomDefaults' should not appear after the underscore.
